Machine-made Sandwich Panels

Machine-made sandwich panels are factory-produced insulated building panels manufactured using an automated continuous production line. They combine pre-painted steel sheets with insulation core materials such as EPS, Rock Wool, PU, or PIR to provide thermal insulation, structural strength, and efficient installation.

Compared with conventional building materials, machine-made sandwich panels deliver consistent quality, accurate dimensions, and reliable performance. They are widely used in modular buildings, container houses, warehouses, workshops, cold storage facilities, and other prefabricated structures.

Why Choose Machine-made Sandwich Panels?


Machine-made sandwich panels are designed to improve construction efficiency while maintaining reliable building performance. These insulated panels provide thermal performance and can be produced with different core materials to satisfy various insulation and fire protection requirements. Their lightweight structure also makes transportation, handling, and installation more efficient than many traditional building materials.

Machine-made sandwich panels are suitable for both temporary and permanent buildings, offering a practical solution for projects that require durability, energy efficiency, and rapid construction.

Machine-made Sandwich Panels Applications


Machine-made sandwich panels are widely used in prefabricated construction projects where fast installation, insulation performance, and long-term durability are essential. Typical applications include container houses, modular offices, industrial workshops, warehouses, cold storage facilities, agricultural buildings, commercial buildings, and temporary construction site buildings.

With multiple insulation core options available, machine-made sandwich panels can be selected according to the thermal, acoustic, and fire-resistance requirements of different projects, making them suitable for a broad range of climates and operating environments.

Why Choose NEW BRAND Machine-made Sandwich Panels?


NEW BRAND combines automated manufacturing with years of experience in modular building to supply machine-made sandwich panels to customers worldwide. Every project can be customized according to specific application requirements, including insulation core material, panel thickness, steel sheet thickness, surface finish, color, length, and other technical specifications.

Whether you are sourcing sandwich panels for container houses, industrial facilities, warehouses, or other prefabricated buildings, NEW BRAND can provide customized manufacturing solutions for projects of different scales.

Contact our team to discuss your project requirements, and we will recommend the most suitable machine-made sandwich panel solution based on your application, insulation needs, and project specifications.

These high density polyurethane sandwich panels are designed for roofing and wall applications, providing excellent insulation and fireproofing capabilities. With laminated construction, they offer durability and superior performance in various environments.
Fireproof Mgo Board Insulation Waterproof Oxide Boards For Wall Construction
Fireproof Mgo Board Insulation Waterproof Oxide Boards are high-quality building materials specifically designed for wall construction. These boards provide exceptional insulation, moisture resistance, and fireproof properties, making them ideal for enhancing the safety and durability of any structure.
Glass Magnesium Waterproof Partition Ceiling Mgo Board,No Sweating No Chloride Magnesium Sulfate Board
The Glass Magnesium Waterproof Partition Ceiling Mgo Board is a high-quality, durable construction material that offers excellent resistance to moisture and chloride. Its unique magnesium sulfate composition prevents sweat buildup, making it an ideal choice for waterproof and corrosion-resistant ceilings.
Fireproof Mgo magnesia board building materials custom glass magnesium board
The "Fireproof Mgo magnesia board building materials custom glass magnesium board" is a high-quality construction material made from magnesium oxide and custom glass. This durable and fire-resistant board is ideal for various building applications, providing a safe and reliable solution for construction projects.
Modern Foam Building Materials Board Insulation Foam Panel Color Steel Plate Eps Sandwich Panel Sound Proof Wall Panels
The Modern Foam Building Materials Board is a color steel plate EPS sandwich panel designed for wall insulation. The soundproof wall panels provide excellent thermal insulation and noise reduction, making them an ideal choice for contemporary construction projects.
Lightweight Prefab Fire-proof Sound Proof Rock Wool Sandwich Wall Panel For External Wall
The "Lightweight Prefab Fire-proof Sound Proof Rock Wool Sandwich Wall Panel For External Wall" is a high-performance construction material designed to provide excellent insulation, fire resistance, and soundproofing qualities for external walls. Its lightweight composition, combined with rock wool insulation, ensures energy efficiency and enhanced acoustic comfort.
Insulated Rock Wool /mineral Fireproof Sandwich Roof Wall Panels For Prefabricated Building Wall Cladding Materials
Insulated Rock Wool/Mineral Fireproof Sandwich Roof Wall Panels are high-quality building materials designed for prefabricated buildings. These panels provide excellent thermal insulation and fire resistance, making them ideal for wall cladding applications.

The "Easy Installation Weather Proof Wall Roof Eps Sandwich Panel" is a cost-effective solution for building exteriors and roofs. Made of polystyrene, these weather-resistant panels offer hassle-free installation and provide excellent insulation properties.
